payload.title: Corpus gold migration to the canonical contract
payload.description:
Migrate the 29-packet corpus and the Jest fixture gold onto the canonical evaluation representation agreed on KDATAP-77d2b0.

This epic is the critical path, and most of it is human judgement rather than code. Measured against the current gold:

| work | scale | nature |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| component keys already taxonomy subtype ids | 481 | mechanical |
| component vendor cases retaining instance | 52 | mechanical |
| `actor:user` with no declared subtype | 30 | blocked on taxonomy |
| mention keys plus source-name promotion | 357 | mechanical once ruled |
| data items keyed on source field names | 308 | **adjudication** |
| data flows with no scorer identity | 436 | **full regold** |

The two adjudication blocks gate the first baseline. They are filed as `annotation` issues so they run the flywheel ladder (labeling to awaiting-review to accepted) rather than being closed by whoever wrote them.

Definition of done: no annotation reaches the evaluator through a legacy key or a hard-coded loader exemption, and the legacy loader has been removed on its stated milestone.
